title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
author: Mark Twain
short_summary: Mischievous Tom Sawyer lives in a small town on the Mississippi River, where he tricks his friends into whitewashing a fence for him and falls for a girl named Becky Thatcher. Late one night, Tom and his friend Huckleberry Finn secretly witness a murder committed by the sinister Injun Joe in the town graveyard. After getting lost in a cave with Becky and surviving a terrifying encounter with Injun Joe, Tom and Huck eventually find a hidden treasure.
extended_summary:
Tom Sawyer is a clever, mischievous boy growing up in the small Mississippi River town of St. Petersburg, always looking for adventure and always finding ways to avoid chores — most famously by convincing his friends that whitewashing his aunt's fence is such fun that they should pay him for the privilege of doing it. Tom is smitten with a new girl in town, Becky Thatcher, and spends much of the story trying to win her attention and forgiveness after their childish quarrels. One night, while sneaking out with his friend Huckleberry Finn, Tom witnesses something no one was supposed to see: the sinister Injun Joe murdering a man in the town graveyard and framing an innocent man for the crime.

Terrified of what Injun Joe might do if he is discovered as a witness, Tom keeps the secret for a long time, torn between fear and his growing conscience. Later, during a school picnic, Tom and Becky become lost in a vast, twisting cave, and their frightening days trapped underground bring them face-to-face with Injun Joe, who is hiding there himself. After Tom and Becky are rescued, the cave entrance is sealed to trap Injun Joe inside for good, and Tom later returns with Huck to search the cave for hidden treasure they suspect Injun Joe hid there — treasure they ultimately find, bringing the boys unexpected wealth and closing out their adventure.
